expectedColumns.name: Date
expectedColumns.note: Future verification: must be ISO YYYY-MM-DD; reject Excel serial dates, US M/D/YYYY, or empty.

expectedColumns.name: Open
expectedColumns.note: Optional. If present, must be positive decimal; reject NaN, empty, 'null', or negative.

expectedColumns.name: High
expectedColumns.note: Optional. If present, must be positive decimal >= Low.

expectedColumns.name: Low
expectedColumns.note: Optional. If present, must be positive decimal <= High.

expectedColumns.name: Close
expectedColumns.note: Required for weekly history. Must be positive decimal with 2-4 decimal places.

expectedColumns.name: Volume
expectedColumns.note: Optional. If present, must be non-negative integer; not used in temperature calculation.

expectedPriceRange.note: QQQ historical range bounds. Any value outside this range must be flagged for manual review, never auto-accepted.

candidateSourceFormatDesign.expectedRowCadenceNote: Source may deliver daily or weekly bars. Weekly history layer must downsample, not interpolate.

verificationChecklistDesign.contentTypeMatchedNote: Future verification: confirm Content-Type header is text/csv, not text/html (HTML error page must be rejected).
verificationChecklistDesign.headerRowPresentNote: Future verification: confirm first non-empty row contains expected column names.
verificationChecklistDesign.columnSchemaMatchedNote: Future verification: confirm column names and order match expectedColumns.
verificationChecklistDesign.dateColumnFormatMatchedNote: Future verification: confirm Date column is ISO YYYY-MM-DD across all rows.
verificationChecklistDesign.priceColumnNumericityVerifiedNote: Future verification: confirm Close column is decimal across all rows; reject NaN, empty, negative.
verificationChecklistDesign.priceRangePlausibilityCheckedNote: Future verification: confirm Close values fall within expectedPriceRange.
verificationChecklistDesign.rowCadenceClassifiedNote: Future verification: confirm cadence is daily or weekly, document which.
verificationChecklistDesign.noHtmlErrorPageMasqueradeNote: Hard rule: if response is HTML (e.g. 404/403/500 error page) but Content-Length non-zero, must reject; never parse HTML as CSV.
verificationChecklistDesign.noPriceFabricationNote: Hard rule: missing prices must remain missing. Never interpolate, never extrapolate, never copy forward.

rejectedFormatScenarios.scenario: HTML error page returned with 200 status
rejectedFormatScenarios.reason: Some sources return HTML error pages with HTTP 200; Content-Type check must catch this. Never parse HTML as CSV.
Empty CSV body is not valid history; must be rejected as transient source error.

rejectedFormatScenarios.scenario: CSV with NaN, 'null', '-', or empty Close values
rejectedFormatScenarios.reason: Missing prices must remain missing. Never substitute with previous-day close or interpolation.

rejectedFormatScenarios.scenario: CSV with US M/D/YYYY date format
rejectedFormatScenarios.reason: Ambiguous date format. Must require ISO YYYY-MM-DD or reject.

rejectedFormatScenarios.scenario: CSV with Excel serial date numbers (e.g. 45000)
rejectedFormatScenarios.reason: Excel-style date serials require conversion; reject as ambiguous source delivery.
QQQ is unlikely to be below $10 or above $2000 in foreseeable history. Out-of-range values require manual review, never auto-accept.

nextAllowedStep: M-21 will open network in throttled mode. Source format verification will only become true under separate manual approval after M-21 network is opened and actual CSV samples can be inspected.
